links.outcome: Concordance of CDS recommendations with MDT decisions on local historical cases across iterative cohorts
links.effect: Concordance improved from 82% to 100% in benign and from 94% to 100% in malignant cases through stepwise refinement on retrospective patient cohorts.
links.quote: Concordance improved from 82% to 100% in benign and from 94% to 100% in malignant cases.

unlisted_practices: Iterative refinement of guideline-based standard-of-care pathway using retrospective cohorts to close knowledge gaps in rule-based CDS

screen.reason: Evaluates a clinical decision support tool for breast MDT meetings using an iterative local validation and refinement process to improve concordance.

primary.practice: iterative local validation and rule refinement
